title: Australian Beef Roast
description: A hearty and flavorful roast beef dish from Australia, perfect for special occasions. This recipe serves a crowd and is sure to impress.
instructions: Rinse the beef roast and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the roast with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over high heat. Sear the roast for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes per kilogram, or until the internal temperature reaches 63°C (145°F) for medium-rare.
Let the roast rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
